outcome: Steroid hormone concentrations in newborn hair and umbilical cord serum
Correlations between steroid hormone concentrations in hair and serum
Associations between pregnancy/birth-related parameters and steroid concentrations
cohort: 42 newborns (50% girls) participating in the Kuopio Birth Cohort, representing typical Finnish pregnancies
finding: This study found positive correlations between steroid hormone concentrations in newborn hair and umbilical cord serum, with minor sex differences and significant associations between parity, delivery mode, and some steroid concentrations.
mod_finding: Delivery mode was one of the significant birth-related parameters associated with cortisol and other adrenocortical steroid concentrations.
